steps.content: [Inside the Sand Ship]

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: Chief, the interrogation room is ready. The walls have been reinforced per your orders, but our resources on the sand ship are limited.
Understood. We're working with what we have. Just maintain a secure perimeter and keep the area clear.
A stack of relevant documents in hand, you make your way to the interrogation room.
[Inside the Interrogation Room]
The door swings open to reveal an empty space.
However, you've spent nearly a week with Synex and know this ruse. You step back swiftly, narrowly evading the whip-crack of a black tail.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Cut it out with these games.

choices.text: Cut it out with these games.

steps.content: Your hand finds the switch on the wall. A surge of intense pressure slams the woman hiding in the shadows flat against the floor. Closing the distance, you see her face is a mask of wild, barely restrained excitement.
Synex, return to your seat.
Your cold response seems to have dampened her excitement. With a theatrical pout, she collects herself and crawls back into her seat.
Synex. The memory of your recent alliance in battle is still fresh, yet now she sits across from you, her beast-like eyes radiating a playful, calculating scrutiny.
What shaped her deranged nature: the influence of the Campbell family, or something she was born with?
A chronological inquiry seems best. You should go through the events one by one.
Synex smiles as you slide the files toward her.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: What do you want to know? The people I killed?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: To be honest, most of them weren't even a challenge. I can barely remember their faces. When you're a dog, you just bite whom your master tells you to.
A review of the case files confirms it: every assassination victim was linked to the Campbell family, with no personal connection to Synex. Her statement checks out.
It sounds like you were very loyal to the Campbell family.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Loyal? You should know, I once tried to assassinate Adelaide. After I failed, he spared my life in exchange for this dog leash.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So rather than the family's dog, I'm more accurately Adelaide's personal hound. Everything I did was on his direct order.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: It's just that Adelaide had an unusually long list of enemies. If I'd been assigned to one of the other family members, my life might have been easier.

options: You seem quite familiar with Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Heheheh... What, you think I'd help her swindle people and ruin their lives? Those crimes sound just as serious as assassination, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Though, that lady's influence stretches much further than Adelaide's. If I'd been assigned to her, I might have met you much sooner.
As she delivers this final line, Synex's tongue darts out to wet her lower lip. You deliberately refuse to interpret the implication.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The young lady... she's one of the few decent people in the Campbell family.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: But if I had served her, I'd still have blood on my hands from protecting her. She just wouldn't have known about it.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So you see, no matter who I served, I was destined to be a criminal. Heh, don't you find that pitiful?
Her voice holds no self-pity; instead, a distinct, mocking undertone colors her words.

Her voice holds no self-pity; instead, a distinct, mocking undertone colors her words.
So you're putting all the blame on Adelaide and the Campbell family...
But from what I know, there's one crime you committed that the Campbells could never have ordered.

steps.speaker: Option
options: The Fraser Institute Information Leak & BR-005 Incident

choices.text: The Fraser Institute Information Leak & BR-005 Incident

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm, fair point. I should clarify my earlier statement. While I was Adelaide's attack dog, I was never what you'd call "loyal."

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Or, let me put it this way... I'd been wanting to stab him in the back for ages. That incident was just when I finally pulled it off.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: After all, whether I was being dragged to the institute for modifications, sent out on an assassination, or prepped as a sacrifice for the Black Ring... it was all so boring. Mind-numbingly dull. Not a shred of fun to be had.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So in the end, I got bored of being Adelaide's dog, and I bit through my own leash.
If things had stopped there, I might have called it justified vengeance.
But the Black Ring incident you triggered affected far more than just the Campbell family.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well, the Black Ring wasn't part of my plan. How was I supposed to know those crafty old foxes had so many backup schemes?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I thought that as the designated core sacrifice, my escape would shut down their entire operation.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Instead, they just turned around and set their sights on poor little Hella.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So I guess I do owe the little one for that. But hey, I helped you during the battle later, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I've been good to you all, right? So, instead of all these boring questions, why not give me a little reward? Come play with me instead...
"Play" with you...?
Before her meaning registers, Synex explodes from her restraints. One hand locks around your wrist as her previously concealed black tail snakes around your lower back.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Yes, come play with me. I've missed your power...
Her tail slithers from your back to twine around your wrist. Its tip traces the rivers of your veins with a lover's delicacy, a predator admiring a weapon in its scabbard.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Use those shackles on me again! The way you did last time, with all your might and murderous intent... Do it to me again! I don't care if it tears me in half!
She fixes you with a gaze of feral excitement, but your response is a firm, unyielding shake of your head.
I don't want to hurt you, Synex. I'm going to keep you here and help you heal.
Easy now. Let's talk this through. Your medical report just came in, and we've already prepared a treatment plan...
Whoosh!
In one fluid motion, Synex backhands the documents aside, seizes your wrist, and slams you against the wall. She pins you there, her forehead pressing firmly against your neck.
Let go of me!
You wrench your wrist and drive a knee hard into her leg, fighting to break her hold.
But your struggle only fuels her. A wild grin spreads across her face as she tightens her grip, her fingers crushing your wrist with renewed force.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, I've already told you. I couldn't care less about healing this body. The only reason I came back with you was for your shackles... they felt so good.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So instead of healing me, why not just... satisfy me with them?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You enjoyed our little game in the storm too, didn't you?
Her words are punctuated by a sudden, sharp bite to your palm, leaving a bloody imprint in your flesh.
Seeing her triumphant smile, you understand this is a deliberate provocation—a ploy to make you use the shackles and play right into her hands.
Are you trying to force me to use my shackles on you?
You could easily indulge her madness, but that would only feed the dangerous game she's addicted to, a cycle with no end.
Your shackles bind her with crushing force.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hehe... Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Yes! That's it... Oh, I'm completely addicted to you now, ${PlayerName}!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: More? Tighter?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ahahahaha! This is incredible! That raw power crashing over me... it's absolutely intoxicating!!
You completely release all tension from your body and open your hands in surrender.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...Huh?
I won't use the shackles on you again until you agree to my terms.
And I won't resist you anymore, either. Do whatever you want.
But if you do, I will never play with you like this again. I mean it.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...? You won't resist?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You'd really just stand there? Even if I tried to kill you?
The world whirls as Synex slams you to the ground, her full weight pinning you.
Your words seem to have ignited a fury. Her jaw unhinges, baring rows of razor-sharp teeth before she sinks them into your neck.
A jolt of white-hot agony electrifies your body. Blood wells up, but true to your word, you only stare back, your gaze unwavering.
Synex, I understand you. You're willful and completely unrestrained. But if you think you can manipulate everyone with a mix of childish tantrums and violent threats, you're wrong.
My shackles aren't a toy, and neither is your life. At least in my eyes, your life is something to be treasured, not treated as a game.

A shift occurs in her blood-red eyes. The last vestiges of reason vanish, leaving a sharp, naked predation. Yet, within that feral hunger, you slowly discern something unexpected—a faint, flickering emotion that looks almost like loss.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...How boring.
With a look of dejection, she releases you and stands up.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Didn't you say you'd do anything to catch me? To put a leash on me like a dog?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: And here I thought I'd finally found the perfect toy. But I suppose... I'm the only one who can ever truly satisfy myself.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Since you won't play this game with me... I'll just have to find my other playmates instead.
Synex leaps onto a nearby filing cabinet. With a single swipe of her claws, she shears it clean in two, sending a blizzard of paper swirling into the air.
You watch her rampage with a deep frown, seeing through her game immediately.
This isn't mindless chaos; it's a calculated performance to provoke you. To lose your temper and activate the shackles would be to play right into her hands.
Undeterred by your disapproving gaze, she shreds a monitoring screen, glass exploding into jagged shards. Broken cables hiss and spit sparks like enraged serpents.
As papers settle on the live wires, they ignite, and in an instant, piercing alarms shriek in unison with Synex's wild, unrestrained laughter.

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: The interrogation room is under attack! Quick, protect the Chief!

Soldiers burst through the door, weapons trained on her. She ignores them completely, casually extending her Aurum Secretum-infused claws and pressing them to the reinforced wall of the interrogation room.
With an ear-splitting screech of tearing metal, golden energy ripples across her claws, and the fortified hull of the sand ship disintegrates at her touch.
Through the fresh breach, a swarm of Alchemic Beasts pours into the ship in coordinated waves, immediately engaging the soldiers in a deadly fight.
In the chaos, Synex seizes her chance. She leaps from the ship, landing gracefully on the back of a massive Alchemic Beast, and flees at a tremendous speed.
I can't let her escape!
Her contained rampage was one thing, but her escape into WhiteSands multiplies the uncertainties exponentially, including the danger to herself.
[Shackles Effect]

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: Open fire!

Bullets streak through the air as crimson light from your shackles lances toward her. One pierces her shoulder. Her body jerks violently, but instead of faltering, she covers the wound and laughs maniacally, showing no intention of slowing down.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hehehe... Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You played with me after all! I'm so happy... so blissful! Hahaha... This is the power I've been craving!

The soldiers' fire targets her head while your shackles bind her legs. Though protected by her beasts, she stumbles slightly. But this barely hinders the creature beneath her as it continues its desperate escape.
You have to make her stay!
(Multiple Shackles Effects)

Sensing your intensified resolve, the Alchemic Beasts leap up, one after another, forming a living shield between you and their master. But how could mere creatures hope to block the power of the shackles?

In an unexpected move, Synex twists around with an air of eerie anticipation, her arms flung wide toward you. Multiple crimson shackles pierce her body simultaneously. Her frame convulses violently from the impact, yet she somehow resists your control, her laughter growing only more maniacal.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...Hahahaha! See? In the end, you couldn't resist giving me exactly what I wanted!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Next time, let's dive into madness together. Let's play until the whole world spins! Just like today... just like before...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Don't you forget me. And don't you dare disappoint me.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: When the mood strikes, I'll come find you again. Until next time, ${PlayerName}.
Synex!!!

Another swirl of sand gusts through the breach. The fleeing Alchemic Beasts converge upon their master, and the figure—her body pierced by countless shackles—is swallowed by the veil of dust, vanishing into the howling winds of WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Subtitles
steps.content: Synex has escaped. Fortunately, the shackles allow you to constantly monitor her location and movements.

steps.speaker: Subtitles
steps.content: She appears to know your location as well, using the very shackles embedded in her body to periodically return to the MBCC, cause a disturbance, and then vanish again.

steps.speaker: Subtitles
steps.content: You've decided to end the pursuit. Now, you simply wait, knowing she will return. You use these fleeting confrontations to your advantage. Deep down, you know the truth: she will never truly break the bond of the shackles, nor will she let Aurum Secretum fully claim her life.
